reviews.text:
Excellent professionals, excellent assistants.
Incredible team.
They saved my cat! 10/10

What we experienced at VetLuz left us outraged.

Our cat was hospitalized for four days. We paid €640 upon admission. Then, we were charged another €140 and €185 – almost €1,000 in total. And, despite having already paid the €640, we received insistent calls demanding payment of the €140, including a call around 10 PM.

But the worst part was the way the cat was returned to us: with a catheter and tubes, without any neck protection. At home, he ended up removing the catheter.

We called the clinic and they told us to come back, informing us that we would have to pay €90 for a consultation and another €85 for an X-ray.

It's difficult to accept that, after such a high expense and four days of hospitalization, our animal was returned in these conditions and that, faced with the problem, the immediate response is to present new costs.

Veterinary care has costs, but pet owners deserve clear information, responsible follow-up, and an explanation of how an animal with a feeding tube can be returned without the necessary protection. Our experience was deeply disappointing and deserves an explanation.

While I was out, my cat, who is diabetic, had a hypoglycemic episode. The woman on the phone was incredibly rude and showed absolutely no sensitivity. She told me he was practically dying, that they didn't know if he would make it, and that he had to be hospitalized for at least 72 hours (Spoiler: NO).
If you have a pet with a chronic illness, you know exactly when someone is trying to pull a fast one on you. During the 24 hours he was hospitalized, they didn't even do a glucose tolerance test (I repeat, this is a DIABETIC CAT). They did some blood work, and that was about it. No ultrasound, no glucose tolerance test, NOTHING. Furthermore, they wouldn't let me visit him during his time in the hospital. If cats are hypersensitive to their surroundings, imagine being in a hostile environment for so long, sick, and without even being allowed to visit. And on top of that, the service was EXTREMELY EXPENSIVE.

Once my cat was stabilized, and only because he'd been treated there, I took him for a check-up. I have NEVER seen my cat so scared of ANYONE, not of a place, but of people. Besides, when I got home he was riddled with wounds, his fur matted... ANYWAY.
When I tell you they gave my boyfriend a pill to drug him for the routine VISIT, that says it all. Since he's been hospitalized, he's afraid of everything and everyone. And he's the calmest cat in the world, he always has been.
I will never take my cat there again. Nor do I recommend anyone else do so.
They are heartless and inspire very little confidence.
Excellent service and care for the animals!
An exceptional and very attentive team, both with the owners and the animals! I highly recommend them!
Very good doctor

I was advised to undergo urgent surgery under general anesthesia to remove a tooth from my dog, who was showing no symptoms, based solely on a photograph, without the surgeon ever having examined the animal. There was strong pressure to decide immediately. A second veterinarian considered the recommendation clinically unjustified and likely motivated by the hospital's financial gain. This is not the first time this establishment has made diagnostic errors (including a misdiagnosed gastric problem) that then have to be resolved elsewhere. I do not recommend them.

Terrible. I went at 4 am with my dog ​​in distress and they told me they couldn't see me because of a computer problem that prevented them from processing the bill. No veterinarian came to help... They just sent me away. A SHAME!!

Very bad for a hospital, or rather, one that calls itself a hospital. I say this because it's anything but that, much less a 24-hour service...
In an emergency with my dog, I had to go to another hospital because they abandoned us at reception... in an emergency...

The dog I sponsor from União Zoofila was admitted here for a gastrointestinal issue, and the service was superb.
Thank you so much for accommodating us.

I contacted the hospital by email to schedule a Veterinary Dermatology appointment. I was told that this specialty did not exist at the hospital. However, the website continues to list Dermatology as one of the available specialties. I requested clarification regarding this discrepancy, but received no response. I consider it important that the information provided to the public is clear and up-to-date, to avoid clients wasting time contacting the hospital for a specialty that, according to the response received, does not exist.

Wonderful experience. We were referred by our own vet, Dr Wooff, for a Saturday afternoon specialist ultrasound, to investigate a bloated stomach. The complete experience was one of professionalism, competence and genuine concern. Ana treated Max, our 49 kilo Maremanno, with kindness, empathy and care. Her manner was simply fabulous. Thank you so much. The facilities were also clean, well organised, and well-equipped.
80% of the time they were burocratic, unfriendly at the desk, the weekends are a no go with little staff, to avoid if you can

Last week, I took my cat Martinha to the clinic, as recommended by another clinic (since they didn't offer night shifts), in a complicated state due to a thyroid problem she had a year ago that almost killed her. We were well received. Dr. Inês, forgive me if I got the name wrong, was very professional. She explained in detail Martinha's condition and the results of the tests done at the other clinic. We agreed to the treatment and hospitalization. Unfortunately, her heart stopped beating and she passed away. We were contacted in the early hours of the morning and told we could say goodbye to her. We returned to the clinic, this time with our son, who had received her with affection when he was seven years old. Now, at twenty, he had to say goodbye to his little friend, which was very painful for him and for us too. We were comforted by the veterinarian on duty (please forgive me again for not remembering her name). She was extremely humane at that moment. The financial aspects were well explained, with only the final settlements remaining. On behalf of myself and my family, I want to express my gratitude for the care you gave our Martinha and the emotional support you provided us. Thank you very much and best wishes to you all, and may you continue the wonderful work you do.

I went to this clinic urgently because our cat has FeLV and had some sores on his neck, and we didn't know why. Since he was already sick, he needed to be very careful and have close monitoring. But when we left the consultation, we were in the same situation; there was no conclusion. We only left with a bill for almost €200 for medication that didn't even apply to his case, and no treatment plan was provided. This was almost a month ago, and the poor animal hasn't improved at all. We called the clinic with questions for the doctor who saw us, but we were only met with a rude "You should have come sooner," even though no one had told us when to return—whether it was before or after the antibiotics ran out. Currently, I'm moving house and I'm not even in Lisbon, so clearly it wasn't possible for me to go to a consultation sooner, but it could have been for financial reasons that I didn't go—you never know what's going on in other people's lives. Meanwhile, we couldn't speak to the doctor because he was very busy, so we asked them to send us the consultation report to give to a veterinarian closer to us, and after promising to... even though they were supposed to do it, they weren't able to provide that.
Impossible to recommend to anyone who truly cares about their animals.

Terrible experience. From the receptionist to the veterinary care. Lack of professionalism and inspires no confidence whatsoever. I paid 160 euros for an emergency consultation and went straight to another clinic for a second opinion because of the lack of confidence I felt! The consultation was rushed, the veterinarian kept me waiting twice, once for more than 15 minutes (even though I was visibly 7 months pregnant), and when I finally called the doctor, I found her chatting in the reception area.

In short, don't waste your time with this clinic because you'll only leave frustrated.
Very caring and competent. Flora loved them.
My dog ​​was treated by Dr. Ivo Espírito Santo, and I have nothing but good things to say about him. He was always available, attentive, and professional. Thank you.
Unfortunately, it has been declining in quality year after year and failing in its customer service.

I only have good things to say. I won't talk about the prices because that's the same everywhere. The sensitivity they have towards our four-legged friends is exceptional. I said goodbye to my companion of the last 16 years yesterday, and the support from VetLuz was exemplary and made everything less difficult. Thank you to the whole team! 🫶🏼

We received emergency care from Dr. Joana Oliveira and we can only say the best: super competent, extremely professional, very attentive and truly caring.

We would also like to express our enormous gratitude to the VET Luz team, especially Dr. Ana Florindo and Dr. Emma Gojalsing, for the care, affection and professionalism with which they always treated our beloved William.

Dr. Ana accompanied him throughout with truly special attention and dedication. Always very kind, available and caring, she made us feel that William was in excellent hands at all times.

In one of the most difficult moments of our lives, Dr. Emma demonstrated extraordinary sensitivity and humanity. The way she conducted the euthanasia was profoundly respectful, calm and full of love, transforming such a painful farewell into a moment of peace and dignity.

We will never forget the care and respect with which they treated William and our family. Thank you so much for everything 🤍

A special thank you from me and my little girl Milka, who came in almost dying and is now recovering very well thanks to the Vetluz team. Dr. Ema, Paula, Diana, Gonçalo. And also the assistants, Rita's. They are lovely, super delicate, sweet and attentive. Erica and Helena from reception too, thank you for your affection and dedication. Thank you all. 😽

Great experience! Our kitten was urgently hospitalized and was away from home for a long week, but visiting her every day, we always saw her very well cared for by very knowledgeable veterinarians. Of course, it's a unique experience for everyone, but for my wife and me, who were almost certain our little one wouldn't come home, seeing her recover so well and so quickly, always receiving immense attention and pampering, made us extremely happy to return home. Unfortunately, as everywhere, it's expensive, and not everyone can afford it. It's a shame that in Portugal we don't have accessible healthcare for our pets, but in case of doubt, I recommend it without a doubt. At least we know that all the money spent was directed to the right place ❤️
Good service, they were fast!

Dr. João Louro operated on a fractured leg in our dog. Initially, he called and gave us a quote on the same day (an operation that cost almost €2300). In the post-operative period, we were not properly instructed on the necessary care. A follow-up X-ray, after the first month, showed that the implants and screws had come loose. Dr. João has remained silent. To this day, we are still waiting for his call regarding alternatives to help our friend... nothing, simply silence... besides a lack of ethics and an extreme lack of humanism, it probably demonstrates guilt, knowing that he didn't do the job properly. Our dog died because he wasn't helped in time, and even today, we are still waiting for the veterinarian's call... regrettable. We are leaving this message to warn other dog owners about this orthopedist.

Terrible vet, they pay to appear first in search results but they're worthless. They performed surgery on my dog ​​and it didn't solve anything; I had to go to another hospital. Besides that, they're expensive, close to €800 for nothing.

A hospital of excellence with an excellent team.
My animals are cared for at VetLuz Hospital with extreme care and affection.
A team that always provides the best care for the animals and also has unparalleled care for the owners.
Our second home!
Thank you for taking such good care of us!

I am a caretaker of two colonies in Lisbon, and someone came forward interested in adopting a cat from one of the colonies, which was recovering from sterilization. The lady, whose name is Sofia Campos, visited the cat and decided to adopt it. I explained to Sofia that, being a cat that is used to being on the street, it may not react well to being confined and may not accept the three cats she already has at home, or vice versa, so the adoption should be done with caution and patience. I also asked her for a photograph of the place where the cat will stay in the first few days until it adapts, which she agreed to, but did not take. I also explained to her that I would be the one to deliver it to the new house, so that the change would be less stressful for the animal, which Sofia agreed to.

Sofia asked me to keep the animal until the end of November because her house was under construction, which I agreed to. However, she asked me to have the cat admitted to the Vet Luz hospital for tests, which I refused because the animal is not vaccinated. Then she asked me to give him to an assistant at the Vet Luz hospital to stay at her house for a while, which I refused because it would stress the animal. Then Sofia asked me to take the cat to the Vet Luz hospital for a consultation. At the consultation, the doctor told me it would be better for him to be admitted for tests and that he would be alone in the infectious diseases ward, so he wouldn't risk being infected by a sick animal. The cat was admitted yesterday, despite not having any clinical condition that justifies it. Today I went to visit him and asked to take him home, but they wouldn't give him to me, arguing that I am not the cat's legal guardian; however, Sofia isn't either, because the cat has a microchip registered to Casa dos Animais de Lisboa (Lisbon Animal Shelter). In other words, since Ms. Sofia doesn't like being contradicted, she decided to deceive me in collusion with the veterinarian, saying that the cat would be hospitalized for some tests, but in practice the goal was to take the cat away from me, even though Sofia hasn't formally adopted it yet.
Therefore, I request that the animal be returned to its legal guardian, which is CAL, because, after the way Sofia acted, I don't trust this person to keep the cat, and there's no justification for keeping the animal hospitalized, especially since it's not vaccinated and could catch a virus at the hospital.
Animals are not objects to throw tantrums over, and the ends do not justify the means.
